Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh have a mammoth task ahead of them now. They have to chase down a target of 424 courtesy a brilliant partnership between Faf du Plessis and Temba Bavuma. The away side did manage to take three quick wickets at the start of this innings but were flat after that. Mominul Haque and Mustafizur Rahman both bowled well with the former taking a 3-fer and the latter picking two. Bangladesh will have to bat out of their skins if they are to reach this total. South Africa on the other hand will hope there are no more rain intervals. Stay tuned for the chase.
SIX! BANG! Top shot! Uses his feet again and gets to the pitch of the ball and tonks it over mid-wicket for a maximum. Finally SOUTH AFRICA HAVE DECLARED AT 247/6.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
In the air... but safe! He advances down the track again and hits it on the bounce to the man at long on. A single added.
FOUR! Picks his spot to perfection! Maharaj comes down the track to the flighted ball on off and hits it over the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Drags his length back outside off, Maharaj has all the time in the world to rock back and push it through covers for a couple.
Shorter in length on off, Phehlukwayo punches it past the diving bowler to long off for a run.
Floats it outside off, Maharaj drives it through the covers for a couple.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Shorter in length on leg stump. The batsman pushes it down to long on for a run.
Gives it a nice loop and bowls it full on off. Maharaj drives it down to long off for a run.
Shorter in length on middle, Andile punches it down the ground off the back foot for a run.
Loopy ball on off, Keshav drives it uppishly past the bowler and down to long off for a run.
Floats it on off, Phehlukwayo defends it solidly.
Advances down the track, Mehedi pulls his length back. Andile defends it.
Comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses it up full on off, Phehlukwayo drives it to long off for a run.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Flatter this time on middle, Phehlukwayo punches it back to the bowler.
Shorter in length on off, Andile punches it down the ground for a run.
Drives it through mid off for a run.
BEATEN! He bowls it slower through the air, gets it to drift in to the batsman and turns away after spinning. Maharaj is beatena s he tries to defend.
No declaration yet! Keshav Maharaj strides out to the middle.

OUT! The part timer has taken a 3-fer! Again, brilliant work by Liton Das. He is having a great time behind the stumps. De Kock comes down the track and seeing that, Haque fires it down the leg side. Quinton misses the flick and Das behind the stumps collects the ball and dives to take the bails off the stumps. Brilliant work and smart bowling.
FOUR! First boundary for Quinton! This time he gets it away form Das! He plays the paddle, fine down the leg side and into the fence.
Works it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shorter in length on middle, the batsman punches it back to the bowler.
Fires it on leg stump, Phehlukwayo works it to mid-wicket.
Tosses it up on off, de Kock drives it through covers for a run.
Flatter on the stumps, de Kock defends it off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Andile Phehlukwayo is the next batsman in. Also Mehedi Hasan is into the attack.

OUT! Yes, it is! Take a bow, Das! That was very good anticipation by him and does very well to cling on. Bavuma and the whole of the South African dressing room cannot believe it. Temba tries to paddle it and he does so to the ball on off. Das behind anticipates and moves to his left, he sticks a hand out and the ball sticks in the glove as he tumbles to complete it. The umpires go upstairs to check whether he has taken it and replays show he has. What a catch that is. A moment to celebrate for Bangladesh. The home side leads by 394.
Brilliant catch! But is it legal? Bavuma has been caught by the keeper and the umpires have to check whether he has taken it cleanly or not.
Very full in length, Bavuma jams it out to the bowler.
Works it with the spin through mid on for a run.
Fires it on leg stump. The batsman punches it down to long on for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, stays low also spins away. Bavuma cuts it to point.
Comes down the track and drives it to long on for a run.
Mominul Haque will continue from the other end.
Good length on off, de Kock taps it towards cover to rotate strike in the next over.
Back of a length on off, de Kock guides it to point.
Fuller in length outside off, Bavuma slaps it through the covers for a run. He wants a second but there was never one in there.
Straightaway some intent! Bavuma walks down the track to a length ball around off but gets a bottom edge to mid on.
We're back now after the delay. The surprising thing is South Africa have not declared and Shaiful Islam will continue his over.
1330 local - Good news guys! The rain has stopped and the covers are also being pulled off. Looks like the clouds have also been blown away and play might resume in a while.

There are sounds of thunder as well and the entire square is covered. Interesting to see what will be Faf's call as and when he might have been looking to declare somewhere around drinks in this session. Stay tuned for the updates.

1300 local - Bad news folks! The rain has arrived, it was expected and it has come. The covers are being brought on and the players have walked off the field. Let us hope the wind blows it away but for now it is raining quite heavily.
Fuller in length on off, Bavuma drives it to mid on.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Quinton de Kock is the next man in.

OUT! Faf du Plessis misses out on a ton! Mominul gets his first. He fires an arm ball on off, the batsman goes down on one knee as he tries to paddle sweep but misses and is struck on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Faf after a chat opts to review and replays show that the there are three reds and the on field call stays.
Review time! Faf has been adjudged lbw and he wants to review it.
No run.
Shorter in length on off, Bavuma guides it to point for a run.
Drives it down to long on for a run.
Flatter on off, Bavuma taps it in front of covers for a run.
Full ball on off, Bavuma eases it towards mid off for a quick single.
Back of a length on off, Bavuma guides it to point.
Fullish ball on off, Bavuma drives it to mid off.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
Fuller in length by the bowler, outside off. Bavuma drives it to the man at sweeper covers for a run.
Angles it into the batsman. Bavuma works it to mid-wicket.
Works it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Floats it up on off, du Plessis drives it to mid off.
Drags his length back, Bavuma punches it down to long on for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller in length outside off, the batsman drives it through covers for a run.
Flatter delviery on off, Faf defends it off the front foot.
Mominul Haque to bowl from the other end.
Just ahead of a length on off, Bavuma drives it crisply to the mat at mid off.
Fullish ball on leg stump, Bavuma drives it to man at mid on.
Errs in line and bowls it down the leg side. Bavuma misses the flick and goes to the keeper.
There are dark clouds hovering above the ground.
Fuller in length, tailing back in. Bavuma drives it to mid off.
Very full almost a yorker! Bavuma does well to dig it out.
Starts off with a full length delivery on middle. Faf drives it straight back towards the bowler who does well to dive to his right and make a half stop but can't prevent a single.
The men concerned are out in the middle. Faf du Plessis and Temba Bavuma will continue their innings. Shafiul Islam will start off the proceedings after the break.
... Day 4, Session 2...

A session which South Africa will be really happy with. They have managed to add 149 runs with Faf du Plessis and Bavuma both unbeaten on half centuries. Bangladesh have been too defensive with their approach which has not put any pressure on the South Africans. They did manage to take Amla early but then it was all about the home side. Faf du Plessis, after coming in has stitched a 133-run partnership with Bavuma which has come in very quick time.  When will the hosts declare is question now on everyone's mind. We will have wait and watch after the break. Join us in a while.
Flatter on the stumps, Faf milks it down to long on for a run. LUNCH ON DAY 4!
Short ball on off, Bavuma waits and punches it through covers for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Bavuma cuts it through point for a couple.
BEATEN! That was a beauty! Haque gives it air outside off, gets the ball to turn after pitching. Bavuma tries to drive it through the off side but gets beaten.
Du Plessis drives it down to long on for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Faf goes for the drive but gets an outside edge through the slip cordon for a couple.
Mominul Haque is into the attack.
Works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Flighted ball on middle, Faf taps it towards mid-wicket and sets off for a run. The fielder is there has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. There is a chance for an overthrow but Bavuma is not interested.
Floats it full outside off, the batsman drives it through covers for a run.
Tosses it up on middle, turning back in. Faf works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Works it with the spin through mid-wicket for no run.
Punches the ball on middle down to long on for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter in length outside off, Bavuma cuts it towards point for a run.
Drives it down to long off for a run.
BOUNCE AND TURN! Flatter and on off, the batsman tries to defend but gets beaten by the bounce and the turn.
Fuller outside off, Faf drives it through covers for a couple.
FOUR! Easy-peasy for Bavuma! Mahmudullah drags his length back and bowls a shorter one outside off. It sits up to be hit. Bavuma goes on the back foot and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Fuller in length on off, Faf drives it down to long on for a run.
Fires it on the pads from around the wicket. Faf against the angle flicks it to the man at mi-wicket.
Floated ball on off, du Plessis defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Works it with the spin towards square leg for a run.
Flatter on off, Bavuma taps it in front of covers and sets off for a run. The fielder is quick and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. It would have been close had it been a direct hit.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Fifty for Bavuma now, his 9th. He has played a good supporting role to Faf. Sabbir serves a full delivery outside off. Bavuma leans into it and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Flicks it against the spin to mid-wicket.
Gives it air on middle, du Plessis drives it past the diving bowler down to long on for a run.
Tosses it up on middle. Faf drives it back to the bowler.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Fuller on the pads, Bavuma works it around the corner for a run.
Fires it on the pads, the batsman clips it through the leg side for a run.
Slower through the air on off, turning in. Bavuma lets the ball do it's bit and then flicks it through square leg for a run.
Works it with the spin towards deep mid-wicket for a run. 100-run stand up between Bavuma and du Plessis.
Quicker on off, Faf defends it off the front foot.
Fires it on the pads, du Plessis flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Drags his length back outside off, Bavuma cuts it hard but straight to the man at deep cover for a run.
Punches the long hop down to long on for a run.
Flatter on the stumps, stays low.Faf in time gets his bat down and blocks it.
Shorter in length outside off, Bavuma punches it through covers for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Similar length and line, this time Bavuma finds the gap through covers for a run.
Tosses it up outside off, Bavuma defends it towards cover.
Fires it on the pads, Bavuma flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter and quicker on middle, Bavuma works it through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the backfoot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Punches it down to long on for a run.
Mahmudullah is into the attack now.
Shorter in length outside off, the batsman pushes it to covers.
FOUR! WOW! That was some shot! Mustafizur bowls it full and outside off, a seam up delivery by him. Du Plessis with ease, strokes it through covers for a boundary.
Works it with the angle towards mid-wicket for a run.
Bangs in a short one, du Plessis sees it early and pulls it through short fine leg for a run.
Good length on off, Bavuma taps it towards point for a run.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
We have bright sunshine now, which is very good news. All the dark clouds which welcomed us in the morning are all gone now.
Fires it on the pads, Bavuma flicks it through square leg for a couple.
Tosses it up outside off, Bavuma drives it to the man at covers.
Faf comes down the track. Sabbir spots this and drags his length back on middle. Du Plessis pushes it back towards him, he fumbles and allows a single.
Drags his length back on middle, Faf pushes it back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shorter in length around off, Faf has a lot of time to push it through the off side for a run.

A very good delivery, also surprised the South African skipper. Mustafizur lands it on a length around off, he rolls his fingers on the ball. It stays low, also nips away after pitching. Faf looks to defend but gets beaten. The keeper behind does well to stop it as the ball goes on the bounce.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Lands it on a length around off, Faf defends it off the front foot.
Angles it into the pads, Bavuma flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Fifty for Faf, his 15th. It has been a very entertaining knock, just as the situation demanded. The Fizz bowls it on the leg stump, Du Plessis flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Mustafizur Rahman is into the attack. He has been Bangladesh's best bowler till now. Can he take another wicket?
Fullish delivery on leg stump. Faf milks it down to long on for an easy single.
A better delivery, fuller in length on middle. The batsman drives it back to the bowler.
A long hop outside off. Bauvma rocks back and cuts it through covers for a run.
Drags his length back on leg stump. Du Plessis drives it down to long on for a run.
Quicker through the air on middle, Bavuma punches it down the ground for a run.
Very slow delivery and also shorter in length. Bavuma paddles it fine down the leg side for a couple.
Sabbir Rahman to bowl.
SIX! BANG! Du Plessis is on the charge here. Mehedi gives it air outside off, Faf seeing that goes down on one knee and tonks it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Driven towards the mid on region.
Floats it up on off, no turn on offer. Du Plessis defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! in the air... but in the gap. Tosses it up on off, Faf sweeps it uppishly but in the gap through backward square leg for a boundary.
Slower one but down the leg side. Faf flicks it through square leg for a run.
Shorter in length outside off. Faf tries to pull it from outside off but gets beaten.
Alters his length and bowls it short on middle. Bavuma just loves it there, he pulls it through square leg for a run.

FOUR! That almost took Taskin's finger off his hand! Fuller in length by Taskin on off, Bavuma drives it powerfully towards the bowler who only gets a finger to it and it beats mid off for a boundary.
Very full on off, almost a yorker! Bavuma does well to jam it out to mid off.
Too full on leg stump, Faf flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.

A long-hop outside off, Bavuma guides it through the vacant point region, due to the slow outfield the ball does not reach the fence and the batsman pick up two. This also brings up the fifty run stand between the two.
Shorter in length outside off, Faf pushes it through the off side for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Drags his length back on off, Bavuma pushes it down to long on for a run.
FOUR! They are now looking to up the ante! Bavuma brings out the reverse sweep to the delivery outside off. He connects well and the ball goes down to the third man fence for a boundary.

FOUR! Lovely use of the feet by the South Africa skipper. He shimmies down the track. Taskin offers him a full ball on the leg stump. Easy for du Plessis, he flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, the batsman defends it off the front foot.
That stays low! Taskin bowls it on a length around off, the ball skids of the surface and also stays low. Faf does well to defend it.
Some more effort in that delivery by Taskin. He lands it on a length on off, du Plessis punches it to the man at mid off.
Fuller in length on middle, too easy for the batsman of Faf's caliber. He flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller in length around off, du Plessis drives it on the up to mid off.
Time for Drinks!
Shorter in length outside off, Faf plays it through the off side for a run.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Quicker outside off, Bavuma gets his pad outside the line and sweeps it to the man at deep backward square leg for a run.
And again, nails the sweep through square leg for a run.
Floats it wide outside off, Faf reaches out for it and drags his sweep through mid-wicket for a couple.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shorter in length outside off, Bavuma punches it hard towards point. The fielder there dives to his right and saves some runs for his team.
Good length on off, Bavuma walks a step or two ahead and drives it to the man at covers.
Just ahead of a length on off, Faf on the up drives it towards mid off and sets off for a run. Hsasn there fumbles and allows the single. Had he collected it, it would have been close.
Fuller in length around off, the batsman drives it to the man at mid off.
No looseners, right on the money. Good length on off, Faf shuffles across and defends it solidly.
Taskin Ahmed is into the attack. Change from both ends now.

FOUR! Cracked! That went to the fence like a tracer bullet! Slower through the air on off, this time by Mehedi. Bavuma goes down on one knee and sweeps it with the spin through square leg and past the diving fielder in the deep for a boundary.
EDGY FOUR! Flighted ball outside off but very full, inviting the batsman to drive. He does so but gets an outside edge through the vacant first slip region for a boundary.
Drags his length back outside off, du Plessis has all the time in the world to rock back and push it through covers for a run.
Works it with the spin to the man at mid-wicket.
Floats it up on off, de Plessis defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it outside off, du Plessis leans into it and drives it through covers for a couple. Good running by the batsmen.
Time for spin! Mehedi Hasan is into the attack.
Length ball on off, Bavuma defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller on the pads, Faf flicks it through square leg for a run.

FOUR! This was beautifully done! Islam bowls it just behind a length on off, Faf rocks back and punches it through cover-point for a boundary. A tough shot to play but he does it so easily. Brilliant!
Back of a length on off, the batsman drives it to the man at covers.
Punched off the backfoot by the batsman.

FOUR! Not where he intended but Faf won't mind. Islam lands it on a length outside off, seeing the width on offer, du Plessis goes after it. He slashes and goes hard. He gets an outside edge over backward point for a boundary.
Fuller in length from around the wicket this time. Bavuma with the angle flicks it to the man at square leg.
Errs in line and angles it on the pads, Faf flicks it down to deep square leg for a run.
Bouncer! A surprise delivery but does not quite have the fizz in it to surprise du Plessis. He ducks out of it with ease.
Changes his angle and comes over the wicekt. He angles it across the batsman on a length. Du Plessis defends it off the front foot.
Lands it on a length outside off, Bavuma lets it through to the keeper.
Very full in length on off, almost a yorker. Faf digs it out to covers.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.

Back of a length on off, Bavuma defends it back to the bowler who scores collects the ball and cheekily scores a direct hit at the striker's end but Faf is inside his crease. Juts a reminder to the non-striker to not take a big start maybe.
Fuller in length outside off, Bavuma pushes it on the up to the man at covers.

And again! Some inward movement for Islam. He bowls it on a length again and gets it to nip into the batsman and also gets some fizz off the surface. Du Plessis somehow manages to work it towards square leg for a run.

That was very well played by Faf! Islam lands it on a length from wide of the crease. He gets it to jag back in sharply after pitching also skids of the surface. Du Plessis does really well to get his bat down in time and defend it.
Good length on off, Faf du Plessis punches it to the man at mid on off the back foot.
Good length on off, Bavuma lunges forward in defense.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Good news for the Bangladesh fans! Looks like Kayes has not done a lot of damage to his hand and since he has not been taken to the hospital he should be fine to open the innings.
Fuller in length on middle, du Plessis chips it through mid on. Taskin Ahmed there jogs after the ball quite lazily and the batsmen take three.
Persists on the length around off, Faf defends it solidly.
Back of a length on off, du Plessis defends it off the back foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length on off, bounces a touch more. Du Plessis pushes it towards mid off and sets off for a run. The fielder rushes in but fails to collect the ball. A single added to the total.
FOUR! Shorter in length on middle, not a lot of pace on that delivery. Faf swivels and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

DROPPED! That was hit very hard but should have been taken. He was exactly placed there for that reason. Islam bowls it shorter in length outside off. Bavuma cuts it hard but straight to Kayes at point who is standing in quite close. He gets two hands to it and drops it. Also the batsmen cross over for a single. Kayes seems to be in pain as he walks off the field holding his hand.
Islam lands it on a length around off, Bavuma shuffles across and works it to the man at mid-wicket.
Good length on off, Bavuma defends it stoutly.
Fuller in length around off, du Plessis defends it solidly.
Comes steaming in and lands it on a length around off. Du Plessis defends it off the back foot.
Length outside off, du Plessis shoulders his arms to it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bowls it on a length around off, Faf defends it off the back foot.
Faf du Plessis, the skipper, comes out to bat.

OUT! Another one with the cutter. A similar one to Markram but this time Amla has edged it. The Fizz bowls it fuller outside off, gets it to grip and move away from the batsman. Amla goes for the drive away from the body but gets an outside edge to Das who takes it easily. The players appeal and Amla starts to walk. An early wicket for Bangladesh, just what they wanted and it is the big one of Hashim Amla.
Aggression! Fuller in length, also gets the ball to tail back into the batsman. Bavuma drives it back to the bowler who collects it and mimes a throw a the striker's end and also gives him the stare.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
This time bowls it on the stumps, Amla works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Again a action replay of Amla's last boundary. Islam bowls a length ball outside off, Amla uses the pace and guides it through short third man for a boundary. Too easy for Hashim.
Lands it on a length around off, the ball stays a touch low. Amla works it towards mid on and opts not to run.
Good length around off, skids off the surface. Amla pushes it to the man at short covers.
Fullish length outside off, a similar delivery to how he got Markram out. Bavuma opts not to play at it.
Change in angle, comes around the wicket and bowls a off cutter on off. Amla plays it towards point with soft hands for a run.
Fuller in length outside off, inviting Amla to drive. He resists and lets it through.
Good length on off, angling away from the batsman. Amla plays the same shot he played to fetch a boundary but this time straight to the gully fielder.
Lands it on a length around off, Amla flicks it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Clever stuff from Hashim Amla. He knows Mustafizur won't be angling the ball into the batsman. He hurls it on a length outside off. Amla guides it past the diving gully fielder and towards third man for a boundary.
Flicks it to mid-wicket with the angle.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Just ahead of a length outside off, Bavuma tries to drive but was not quite driving length. The ball takes the bottom edge and back to the bowler.
Fuller in length swings into the batsman from outside off. Bavuma keeps his eyes on the ball and lets it through.
Lands it on a length outside off, stays a touch low. Bavuma does not fiddle with it.
Comes running in and angles it into the batsman. Amla shuffles across and tucks it towards square leg for a run.
Shafiul Islam is into the attack an early bowling change.
Good length outside off, Bavuma lets it be.
Bavuma pulls out of the very last moment as Mustafizur delivers a delivery. Maybe he had some problem with someone walking behind the bowler's arm.
FOUR! First for the day! Too easy for Bavuma. Mustafizur dishes out a low full toss outside off, Bavuma leans into it and drives it through cover-point for a boundary.
Comes around the wicket outside off, Bavuma shoulders his arms to it.
Back of a length on off, Bavuma guides it towards point the fielder there fumbles but is quick to recover and does not concede a run.
Bowls the off cutter he has been bowling since yesterday but outside off. Bavuma lets it be.
Starts off with a fuller length ball outside off, looking for some swing. Bavuma drives it to the man at covers who makes a good stop.
Mustafizur Rahman will bowl from the other end. He has a slip and gully in place.

Action first up! Taskin bowls it on a length outside off, Bavuma taps it towards point and sets off for a run. The fielder there is quick to it and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. No harm done.
We're all set to get underway. The men who matter are out in the middle. Hashim Amla and Temba Bavuma will continue from where they left off last night. Taskin Ahmed to continue his over.

Hello and welcome to the coverage between South Africa and Bangladesh at Potchefstroom. We head into day 4 as expected, with the home side in a commanding position. They will look to add some quick runs and extend their lead further.  The weather forecast for today and tomorrow is not that promising, so the time of declaration is very important as they would want to give their bowlers enough time to bowl the away side out. Bangladesh on the other hand, would try and not let the hosts score freely and the best way to do that is to keep chipping away at the wickets. We are in for an action-packed day of cricket.
...Day 4, Session 1...

So, that's all for today. Bangladesh are trying to fight back into the game but they are still a long way behind. They managed to take two wickets but in spite of that, they will be worried as the lead has already reached 230 runs. The forecast for tomorrow is not promising but let's hope for the best. Join us for the fourth day at 1000 local (0800 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!

Stumps on day 3! Another good day for South Africa and they have strengthened their position in this Test match. Their bowling was superb today, after the initial period where they looked a bit flat. The pacers did most of the damage and made the Bangladesh batsmen jump around with extra pace and bounce. Keshav Maharaj was also effective as he finished with a 3-fer. Mominul Haque and Mahmudullah stood out for the visiting team but apart from them, there wasn't much fight shown.

1645 Local - Bad news, folks! Both the umpires have come together to have a word as it has gone really dark out there. They have asked the players to walk off for now but to be honest, it doesn't seem like they will come back again. The light meter is out and the reading that they have got does not please them either, now the fourth umpire also comes out and together they have called for precautionary covers. Should be it for the day, let's wait for the official confirmation...
Short and angling in, comes slowly off the deck, Amla shovels the pull to deep backward square leg for a single.
Bangs in a short ball, it's too high and Amla lets it sail over him to Liton Das behind. The umpire stretches his arms to call it a wide.
Good length delivery on middle, defended with straightest of bats.
Touch fuller outside off, driven on the up towards the cover fielder.
Good ball! Very full and attacking the base of the middle stump, Amla is quick to bring his bat down to jam it out back to the bowler.
FOUR! That's Hashim Amla at his best! Stands tall to a back of a length delivery outside off and packs a punch through covers to pick up a boundary. 50 comes up for SA!
The lights have deteriorated and as a result the floodlights have taken effect. It has gotten quite dark out there.
Goes around the wicket for the last ball of the over, angles it in from outside off, Bavuma keeps his bat inside the line and makes an easy leave.

Chance of a run out! Amla works it in front of mid-wicket and calls for a quick single. Shafiul Islam there attacks the ball and in quest to have a shy at the non-striker's end, he takes his eyes off the ball. Amla gets to the other end safely. Hashim could have been struggling had Islam scored a direct hit. Risky!
Keeps it on a good length outside off, Amla stays put and glides it with an angled bat towards gully.
Good length ball, pitched outside leg, the little man tickles it with soft hands towards square leg and picks up a single.
Pitches it really full this time, Temba leans ahead, keeps his head straight and digs it out towards cover.
Mustafizur Rahman from over the wicket, slants it away on a good length, Bavuma is rock solid in defense.
Closer to the off stump this time but not close enough to make Amla play at it.
Length ball outside off, Amla lets it be.
Shortish length outside off, Amla punches it through covers. The man there dives over the ball and lets it through. The man in the deep does the mopping up job. Two taken by the batsmen.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Similar length and a similar shot by Bavuma towards covers to change strike.
Back of a length outside off, Amla pushes it towards deep cover and takes a run.
Fuller in length outside off from around the wicket. Bavuma feels for it but gets beaten.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Slightly fuller in length outside off, Bavuma strokes it on the up to covers.
Lands it on a length around middle, angles away from the batsman. Bavuma with a half stride forward blocks it.
Just ahead of a length outside off, angling away. Bavuma lets it be.
Good length delivery on off, Bavuma defends it off the front foot.
Flicks it with the angle through mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller in length on middle, Amla drives it straight back. The bowler shows some good football skills as he stops it with his leg.

Shorter in length, does not quite bounce that high. Bavuma tucks it towards mid on and sets off for a run. The fielder is quick to the ball but fires a wayward throw at the non-striker's end. No harm done.
Good length delivery on off, stays low. Bavuma does really well to get his bat down in time.
Shorter in length outside off, Amla cuts it through point for a run.
Length ball on off, angling into the batsman. Amla pushes it down to mid off.
Temba Bavuma is the next man in. Taskin Ahmed is brought into the attack as well.
Time for Drinks!

OUT! The change of angle does the trick for Mustafizur! Markram departs early this time. The Fizz rolls his fingers on the ball and bowls it full outside off. Inviting Markram to drive, he obliges but gets an outside edge in doing so to the keeper who takes it. Two early wickets for Bangladesh and they are a happy bunch at the moment. Now then, replays show that there was a gap between bat and ball, also, there is no spike on Ultra Edge as the ball passes the bat. Why didn't Markram review? Maybe he thought he had hit it. Strange, really strange. As a batsman, you mostly will know when you have not hit. The noise there clearly came when the bat hit the pitch. Unlucky. In spite of having all the technology and the new rules, there is a sorry dismissal.
Off cutter outside off, Markram defends it towards point.
Shorter in length outside off, sticks on the surface. Amla is early into the pull and he gets it off the toe end through the vacant mid-wicket region for a run.
Good length outside off, Amla opts not to fiddle with it.
Lands it on middle, Markram flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Just ahead of a length around middle, angling away. Amla guides it down to third man for a run.
Back of a length outside off, Amla guides it towards point for a run.
Just ahead of a length on off, Amla crisply drives it to the man at covers.
Shorter in length outside off, Markram cuts it through point for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Errs in line and drifts it on the pads, too easy for Amla, he flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Islam lands it on a length on off, Amla pushes it to mid off.
The surprise delivery, a bouncer on leg stump. Amla pulls it through square leg for a run.
Fuller in length outside off, Amla guides it towards point.
Length ball outside off, Amla shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller in length outside off, Amla lets it be.
Good length on off, angling away from the batsman. Amla pushes it down to mid off.
Starts off with a loosener down the leg side. Markram flicks it through square leg for a run.
Mustafizur Rahman is into the attack.
Length ball on middle, Amla punches it to mid on.
Back of a length on off, Amla pushes it to covers.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Hashim Amla is the next man in.

OUT! Islam strikes! Elgar has to walk back and also takes a review with him. Shafiul comes running in and lands it on a length around off, the ball jags back in sharply. Elgar who walks across a long way, tries to flick but fails to do so and the ball strikes the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Elgar straightaway reviews. Replays show three reds and the on-field call stands. That's hitting the leg pole.
Review time! Elgar has been adjudged LBW and he has opted to review. Looks very, very close.
Fuller in length on off this time, Elgar drives it off the toe end to the man at mid off.
Good length on off, Elgar guides it towards backward point for no run.
Flatter on middle, Markram blocks it.
FOUR! WOW! Delightful! That made some sound of the bat. Mehedi tosses it up on off, with no turn on offer. It is easy for Markram as he leans into it and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Floats it full and outside off, turning back in. Markram is solid in defense.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tosses it up outside off, Elgar drives it through covers for a run.

Shorter in length on middle, Markram pushes it back to the bowler who almost deflects it back onto the non-striker's end. In the attempt of doing so he misses and the ball goes down towards long on for a run.
Back of a length outside off, Elgar off the back foot pushes it through the off side for another couple.
Fullish length outside off, Elgar times it off the middle of the bat through covers and bags a brace.
Good length on off, shoots off the surface after pitching. Elgar first thinks about guiding it down but then pulls his bat out.
STREAKY FOUR! Islam lands it on a length around off, nips away after pitching. Elgar tries to defend it but gets an outside edge through the vacant first slip area and down to the third man fence.
Just ahead of a length on off, Elgar eases it to the mat at cover-point.
Shorter in length outside off, does not quite bounce that much. Elgar with ease guides it to point.
Fires it in outside off, Markram goes on the back foot and defends it.
Flighted ball around off, Elgar leans into it and drives it through covers for a run.
Flatter on off, goes on with the arm. Elgar defends it watchfully.
Works it with the spin through square leg for a run.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! He continues from where he left off in the first innings. Mehedi floats it full on off, Markram drives it through mid on and into the fence.
Slower through the air on off, Elgar lets it turn away and then strokes it through covers for a run.
Lands it on a length on the stumps, angling into the batsman. Elgar flicks it through square leg to keep strike.
Just ahead of a length on off, Dean blocks it towards covers.
Back to bowling length on off, Elgar defends it solidly.
FOUR! This time he pulls it with a lot of power! Shortish length on the body of the batsman. Elgar swivels inside his crease and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter in length outside off, Elgar tries to drag his pull through the leg side but fails to connect.
Comes around the wicket and lands it on a length around off. Elgar plants his front foot ahead and defends it.
Similar line and length on off, Markram lunges forward in defense.
Tosses it up on off, turning back in. Markram defends it onto the ground.
Quicker delivery outside off, the batsman shoulders his arms to it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter on off, no turn on offer. Markram defends it solidly.
Fires it on middle, Markram prods forward and blocks it.
Fuller in length looking for some swing, there isn't any. Elgar eases it down to mid off.
Back of a length on off, bounces a touch more. Markram taps it towards point and takes a run.
Fullish in length outside off, inviting Markram to drive. He does not need to and lets it through to the keeper.
Full and wide outside off, Markram watchfully lets it be.
Fuller in length, gets some away shape from the batsman on off. Markram defends it with a straight bat.
He lands it on a length around off, angling it away from the batsman. Elgar defends it towards point and sneaks through for a run.
Shafiul Islam will bowl from the other end. He has a slip and a gully in place.
Floats it on off, turning back in. Markram defends it off the front foot.
Works it against the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Gives it air on off but it is too full. Elgar plants his front foot ahead and drives it to mid off.
Quicker but outside off, Elgar need not play at it.
Tosses this one up on off, Elgar drives it down to mid off.

Starts off with a flatter delivery but shorter in length on middle, turning back in. Markram has all the time in the world to rock back and flick it through square leg for a run. First run in this innings for South Africa.
